title: v-memo  v-for with inline array iteration error "can't access property "el", oldVNode is undefined"

labels.name: :exclamation: p4-important
labels.description: Priority 4: this fixes bugs that violate documented behavior, or significantly improves perf.

body:
### Version
3.2.0-beta.7

### Reproduction link
[sfc playground](https://sfc.vuejs.org/#)

this is inline example that does not work an raise the error
```js
// [1,2,3] inline array
v-for="v,k in [1,2,3]"
```

the following will work as expected ( when arr = [1,2,3] ) 
```js
v-for="v,k in arr"
```

### Steps to reproduce
open sfc 
1. click inc button 3 times, when v-memo trigger a change the error will show.

### What is expected?
no error

### What is actually happening?
```
Uncaught (in promise): can't access property "el", oldVNode is undefined
```
